notes: Godot 4.5 3D turret-defense jam entry named Expansion: main menu, pause, win/lose, and a turret testing-grounds level with build spots, enemy flyers/tanks/carriers, and wave sequencer. Art is engine CSG/primitive meshes plus two tiny UI rasters (solid damage-indicator color and a simple reticle); no fonts, no audio, no addons, no Git LFS, no editor .tmp. icon.svg is an original slate-and-ochre turret-with-expansion-ring mark (md5 ce91ab4832a513e2db6aede9685492a7), replacing the Godot default project icon.
